decisions.statement: The group of readings served is the one thing named here.
The readouts the group has are read off the readout pages.
A readout's label and wire key are read off that readout's page.
A readout's scale is read off that readout's page.
A reading's color is the rung that reading reaches on the scale.
A readout joining the group reaches the tile without this route changing.
The readings served here are Alan's rather than Jenny's.
Jenny's tile and Alan's site show one reading rather than two readings taken twice.
A caller into this ring presents Jenny's ring credential.
A readout with no fresh reading answers a stoplight with no figure.
Only a group no readout is left in answers 503.
Jenny's shipped widget decodes `stoplights` as a list holding at least one stoplight.
Jenny's shipped widget decodes a stoplight's tier as one of six color names.
The readings this route's tests read are fixtures rather than Alan's own.
`readingHeld` says no reading was ever taken.

definition: Alan's upkeep as the stoplights Jenny's tile draws those readings in
